title: Gilead
author: Marilynne Robinson
summary: John Ames, an elderly minister in a small Iowa town in the 1950s, writes a long letter to his young son. He knows he is dying, and he reflects on family, faith and the town's history.
readIf: you like quiet, reflective novels about faith, fatherhood and small daily graces.
skipIf: you want action or a plot that moves along, since little happens on the surface.
